in_sanskrit.name: Aniruddha
in_sanskrit.meaning: Beyond the reach of Sudha, or beyond the reach of the mind, or not to be grasped

in_hindi.name: अनिरुद्धशिंह
in_hindi.long_meaning: Ani- (अनि) + rudh- (रुद्ध) + dha- (ध) + sinh- (शिंह) - ani (अनि) means not, rudh (रुद्ध) means to seize, dha (ध) means placed, sinh (शिंह) means lion

in_marathi.name: Aniruddhsinh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ani- Rudra's Lord, Sinh- Lion
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aniruddhsinh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ani- (Ani- Rudra) meaning 'Rudra's', Sinh- (Sinh Asvatthama) meaning 'Lion'. The name Aniruddhsinh is a combination of Aniruddha and Sinh. Aniruddha is a name of Lord Krishna who was the son of Lord Krishna and Rukmini. Sinh is a royal and powerful name derived from the lion. This name suggests the strength and courage of a king and the wisdom of a god.

The name Aniruddhsinh is a combination of Aniruddha and Sinh. Aniruddha is a name of Lord Krishna who was the son of Lord Krishna and Rukmini. Sinh is a royal and powerful name derived from the lion. This name suggests the strength and courage of a king and the wisdom of a god.
